item.title: Bulletin updated at 21:05 HKT 15/Jun/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Wutip will move further into inland areas and dissipate gradually today. Under the influence of an active southwesterly airstream, there will be occasional heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually, the weather over Guangdong will improve and it will be hot apart from a few showers in the middle and latter parts of this week.

Date/Month: 16/06 (Monday)
Wind: Southwest force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers and squally thunderstorms. Showers will become more frequent during the day, heavier in some areas.
Temp range: 26 - 29 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
